source: 1902 Tables for Computing and Projecting Graticules of Sheets of Indian Atlas.pdf
scope: Latitude 16–18 only; no extrapolation. Historical table coordinates are not a modern datum transformation.
transcription: Radii checked in original PDF page 9; detailed angles and sine values checked on PDF pages 25–27. Offset 9 is blank for latitude 16, so checks use printed offsets 7 and 8. Latitude 17 sine at offset 8 is 465459.5, verified in enlarged source crop.
